meta.note: Synthetic data. Okta groups are pushed from the Access OU; resolving group nesting (member/memberOf, possibly circular) gives each employee's effective access. Every account is also a member of Domain Users via primaryGroupID 513. Accounts join identities on employeeID; admin accounts share their owner's employeeID and service accounts have none. Fields prefixed with '_' are HybridGuard annotations, not AD attributes.
